html5-qrcode 2.3.8 (Apache-2.0), copied unchanged from the npm package, file html5-qrcode.min.js.
QR scanner used by the Send screen in pay.html, pay2.html and pay5.html. Update by replacing the file and bumping ?v= in those pages.
qrcode-generator 2.0.4 (MIT, qrcode-generator.js in this folder) is the QR drawing library used by shared/qr.js.
@supabase/supabase-js 2.117.3 (MIT, supabase.js in this folder, license in supabase-js.LICENSE), copied unchanged from the npm package, file dist/umd/supabase.js (the same file jsDelivr and unpkg serve for this package). Defines the global `supabase`. Loaded by every app and public page with `/shared/vendor/supabase.js?v=1`. Update by replacing the file and bumping ?v= on every page.
lucide 0.460.0 (ISC, lucide.min.js, license in lucide.LICENSE), copied unchanged from the npm package, file dist/umd/lucide.min.js (what unpkg serves for this package). Defines the global `lucide`. Loaded with `/shared/vendor/lucide.min.js?v=1` (defer). Before bumping the version, check that every data-lucide name in use still exists (see CLAUDE.md).
jspdf 2.5.1 (MIT, jspdf.umd.min.js, license in jspdf.LICENSE) and html2canvas 1.4.1 (MIT, html2canvas.min.js, license in html2canvas.LICENSE), copied unchanged from npm (dist/). Used by the receipt download in tx.html.
chart.js 4.4.0 (MIT, chart.umd.js, license in chart.js.LICENSE), copied unchanged from npm (dist/chart.umd.js). Used by analytics.html and research/usdc-report-2026.html.
Note: the minified files end with a sourceMappingURL comment but the .map files are not shipped. This only causes a harmless 404 when browser dev tools are open.
Wallet SDK bundles (sequence-waas.js, onramp-web-sdk.js) are built from npm packages with esbuild, see ../../vendor-build/README.md. Do not edit them by hand. They replace the old runtime imports from esm.sh and jsDelivr. Loaded as ES modules: `import { SequenceWaaS } from '/shared/vendor/sequence-waas.js?v=1'`.
Font Awesome Free 6.4.0 (fontawesome/, license in fontawesome/LICENSE.txt: icons CC BY 4.0, fonts SIL OFL 1.1, code MIT), copied from npm @fortawesome/fontawesome-free: css/all.min.css and webfonts/*.woff2. The .ttf fallback files are not shipped (every current browser uses woff2), so those url() entries in the CSS are never requested. Used by page-builder.html (editor and its preview iframe) and api/landing.js (published landing pages). vercel.json sends Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * for the webfonts folder because the preview iframe is sandboxed (opaque origin) and needs CORS to load the fonts.
